text: Worker-6 evidence: this production gap now fails the routing_dispatch host suite on main. lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/src/main.c:755 (test_dtn_hbh_option_parsing, added by 6abcb23ce2 'DTN expire coverage + zero-expiry drop case') expects lichen_router_dtn_expire(&router, 100U) == 1 — flush of the fail-open clockless store once valid wall-clock arrives — but it returns != 1, so the standalone and native_sim suite both fail at main tip (verified on a pristine main worktree AND a clean standalone build; suite blocks all later inner tests including the new ipv6-in-ipv6 decap tests). Fixing this bead's production behavior should turn the suite green; run 'lichen/tests/routing_dispatch' standalone (unset ZEPHYR_BASE) or native_sim to verify.
